medicines: 💊 Oseltamivir (Tamiflu) 75mg - Take twice daily for 5 days
💊 Ibuprofen 400mg - Every 8 hours for body aches
💧 Plenty of fluids - Water, juice, warm lemon water with honey
dosage_instructions: ⏰ Take Tamiflu within 48 hours of symptom onset
🍽️ Can be taken with or without food
⚠️ Complete the full 5-day course even if feeling better
advice: 🛏️ REST: Get 8-10 hours of sleep per night
💧 HYDRATION: Drink at least 8-10 glasses of water daily
🏠 ISOLATION: Stay home for at least 7 days or until fever-free for 24 hours
🤧 HYGIENE: Cover mouth when coughing, wash hands frequently
🌡️ MONITOR: Check temperature twice daily
📞 SEEK HELP: If difficulty breathing, chest pain, or confusion develops
Influenza.when_to_see_doctor: If symptoms worsen after 3 days or difficulty breathing occurs

medicines: 💨 Albuterol (Rescue Inhaler) - 2 puffs every 4-6 hours as needed
🆘 Keep emergency inhaler with you ALWAYS
dosage_instructions: ⏰ Use controller inhaler even when feeling well
📱 Use spacer device with inhaler for better delivery
🫁 Wait 1 minute between puffs
👄 Rinse mouth after using steroid inhaler
advice: 🚭 AVOID TRIGGERS: Smoke, dust, pollen, pet dander, cold air
💨 BREATHING EXERCISES: Practice pursed-lip breathing daily
🏃 EXERCISE: Moderate activity with proper warm-up
📊 PEAK FLOW: Monitor peak flow readings daily
🆘 EMERGENCY: Use rescue inhaler, call 911 if no improvement in 15 min
💊 NEVER SKIP: Controller medications even when feeling well
Asthma.when_to_see_doctor: Using rescue inhaler more than 2x/week, nighttime symptoms

medicines: 💉 Insulin (if prescribed) - As per endocrinologist schedule
📊 Blood glucose test strips - Test before meals and bedtime
🍬 Glucose tablets - Keep for hypoglycemia emergencies
dosage_instructions: 🍽️ Take Metformin with food to reduce stomach upset
💉 Rotate insulin injection sites to prevent lumps
❄️ Store insulin in refrigerator, not freezer
📊 Test blood sugar: Fasting and 2 hours after meals
advice: 🍽️ DIET: Follow diabetic meal plan - low carb, high fiber
🏃 EXERCISE: 30 minutes daily walking or moderate activity
📊 MONITORING: Check blood sugar 3-4 times daily
👣 FOOT CARE: Inspect feet daily, moisturize, proper footwear
💉 INSULIN STORAGE: Keep at room temp for 28 days, refrigerate new
🚨 HYPOGLYCEMIA: Treat immediately with 15g fast-acting carbs
Diabetes.when_to_see_doctor: Blood sugar consistently >300 or <70, ketones in urine

medicines: 💊 Lisinopril 10mg - Once daily in the morning
dosage_instructions: ⏰ Take at the same time daily
🚫 NEVER skip doses or stop suddenly
📊 Monitor BP daily - same time, same arm
💊 Swallow whole, do not crush or chew
advice: 🧂 DIET: Limit salt drastically - read all labels
🏃 EXERCISE: 30-45 minutes daily moderate cardio
📈 MONITORING: Check BP daily, keep log book
😌 STRESS MANAGEMENT: Meditation, yoga, deep breathing
⚖️ WEIGHT: Lose 5-10% body weight if overweight
🚫 AVOID: Alcohol, smoking, excessive caffeine
Hypertension.when_to_see_doctor: BP >180/120, severe headache, vision changes, chest pain

medicines: 💊 Amoxicillin 500mg - Three times daily for 7-10 days
dosage_instructions: ⏰ Complete FULL antibiotic course
🍽️ Take with food if stomach upset
💧 Drink extra fluids with antibiotics
⚠️ Do not stop early even if feeling better
advice: 💊 ANTIBIOTICS: Complete full course - critical!
💧 FLUIDS: Drink warm liquids - soup, tea, water
🛏️ REST: Complete bed rest for 1-2 weeks minimum
🌡️ MONITOR: Temperature, breathing rate, oxygen levels
🚨 EMERGENCY: Difficulty breathing, bluish lips, confusion
🔄 FOLLOW-UP: Chest X-ray 6 weeks after treatment

medicines: 🍯 Honey with warm lemon water - 3-4 times daily
dosage_instructions: ⏰ Take decongestants for max 7 days only
💧 Increase fluid intake significantly
🌡️ Alternate Acetaminophen/Ibuprofen if needed
🍯 Honey is natural cough suppressant

🛏️ REST: Extra sleep helps immune system
🤧 HYGIENE: Wash hands every 2 hours, sanitize surfaces
🏠 ISOLATION: Stay home to avoid spreading
🍯 HONEY: Natural remedy for cough (not for infants <1 year)
⏱️ DURATION: Symptoms typically resolve in 7-10 days

dosage_instructions: 💨 Use inhaler properly with spacer

dosage_instructions: ⏰ Take at same time daily
